Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering,Nagpur. 

Subject : Request for the permission to grant attendance to students engaged attending Overseas Education Guidance 
Session. 

We request your kind permission to allow the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th year students to attend a guidance session on pursuing 
higher education abroad, organized by Shahs Overseas. The session will be held on 18th August 2025 from 12:00 pm to 
2:00 pm, where students will be informed about the process, requirements, and benefits of pursuing a Masters degree 
overseas. 

This session will provide valuable insights for their future academic and career planning. 
We kindly request your approval to mark the attendance of the students for this session. 
Sincerely, 

Dr. Lalit Damahe HP Omen
